# Teams API

Manage teams and membership. Requests remain subject to your account and team permissions.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/team` | [List teams](#op-get-v1-team) |
| `POST` | `/v1/team` | [Create team](#op-post-v1-team) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/{id}` | [Get team](#op-get-v1-team-id) |
| `PUT` | `/v1/team/{id}` | [Update team](#op-put-v1-team-id) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/team/{id}` | [Delete team](#op-delete-v1-team-id) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/deployment-context` | [Get deployment context](#op-get-v1-team-deployment-context) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/members` | [List team members](#op-get-v1-team-members) |
| `GET` | `/v1/team/invitations` | [List team invitations](#op-get-v1-team-invitations) |
| `POST` | `/v1/team/invitations` | [Invite a team member](#op-post-v1-team-invitations) |
| `POST` | `/v1/team/invitations/{id}/resend` | [Resend team invitation](#op-post-v1-team-invitations-id-resend) |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/team/invitations/{id}` | [Revoke team invitation](#op-delete-v1-team-invitations-id) |

## List teams {#op-get-v1-team}

`GET /v1/team`

Returns a paginated list of Team

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |
| `page` | query | no | Page number |
| `per_page` | query | no | Items per page |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/team" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

List of Team

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | array |  |
| `data[].created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `data[].description` | string |  |
| `data[].owner_id` | string |  |
| `data[].parent_id` | string |  |
| `data[].status` | string |  Allowed: active, inactive, suspended, deleted. |
| `data[].team_id` | string |  |
| `data[].title` | string |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `pagination` | object |  |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Current page number |
| `pagination.per_page` | integer | Number of items per page |
| `pagination.total` | integer | Total number of items |

Illustrative example; not a live response:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "created_at": 1791072000,
      "deleted_at": 0,
      "description": "",
      "owner_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "parent_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "status": "active",
      "team_id": "000000000000000000000000001",
      "title": "Postman example",
      "updated_at": 1791072000
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "per_page": 1,
    "total": 1
  }
}
```


## Create team {#op-post-v1-team}

`POST /v1/team`

Creates a new Team

This request changes data or starts an action. Review the target and body before sending it.

Request fields (the body contains an editable example):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | string | no |  Default: `""`. |
| `owner_id` | string | yes |  |
| `parent_id` | string | no |  |
| `status` | string | yes |  Allowed: active, inactive, suspended, deleted. Default: `"active"`. |
| `title` | string | yes |  |

Authentication: bearer token and the team header shown below.

### Parameters

| Name | Location | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `X-Tenant-ID` | header | yes | Active team ID. Must match the tenant bound to a diagnostic token. |

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request POST "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/team" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: $ADIOS_TEAM_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @- <<'JSON'
{
  "owner_id": "YOUR_USER_ID",
  "title": "Postman example team",
  "status": "active"
}
JSON
```

Replace `YOUR_*` body placeholders before sending. The quoted heredoc keeps the JSON literal.

### Response: HTTP 201

Team created

### Response fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `created_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `deleted_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
| `description` | string |  |
| `owner_id` | string |  |
| `parent_id` | string |  |
| `status` | string |  Allowed: active, inactive, suspended, deleted. |
| `team_id` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `updated_at` | integer |  (Unix timestamp) |
